# Required

```{r}
# install.packages("here") if needed
library(here)
source(here("scripts_notebooks", "required.R"))
```

# 1. Download datasets

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
#Download datasets
filename = "Example_GSEXXXX"

GSE_matrix <- getGEO("GSEXXXX", GSEMatrix = TRUE) 

#Get Expression Set
eset <- GSE_matrix[[1]] #Some series may have two or more eSets listed

#Get metadata -------
GSE_metadata = eset %>% pData()

#Select, clean, and standardize attributes
GSE_metadata_annotated = GSE_metadata %>% 
  select(geo_sample = "geo_accession") %>% 
  mutate(treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "reference"))

#Save metadata
write_csv(GSE_metadata_annotated, file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_metadata_annotated.csv")))

#Get counts matrix ------
GSE_exprs <- eset %>% exprs()

#Save as RDS
GSE_exprs %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "exprs.rds")))

```

## Annotate genes

### Mouse datasets

```{r}
#Import datasets
ecoli_mouse_exprs = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_exprs.rds"))
ecoli_mouse_human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Inputs
filename = "ecoli_infection_mouse"
mouse_exprs = ecoli_mouse_exprs
mouse_metadata = ecoli_mouse_human_metadata

#Annotate genes ------
#Mouse -----
#Annotate data and calculate log2fc
mouse_exprs_metadata  = mouse_exprs %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:125,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata, 
             by = "geo_sample") 

mouse_exprs_metadata_filtered = mouse_exprs_metadata %>% 
               filter(host_strain == "C57BL/6J",
                      batch == "8")

#Save metadata
mouse_exprs_metadata_filtered %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_metadata_filtered.rds")))

#Get value from day 0 and calculate Log2FC (non-paired)
mouse_exprs_log2fc_sample = mouse_exprs_metadata %>% 
  #Filter batch
  filter(organism == "Mus musculus",
         status == "Healthy",
         host_strain == "C57BL/6J",
         batch == "8") %>% 
  select(probe_id, batch, subject_num, day0_value_raw = value_raw) %>% 
  #If the dataset is paired, ignore this part
  ########################
  #Get the mean expression value for healthy
  group_by(probe_id, batch) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            #Mean of healthy
            day0_value_raw = sum(day0_value_raw)/n,
            batch) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ########################
  select(probe_id, day0_value_raw, batch) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  #Filter batch
  inner_join(mouse_exprs_metadata %>% 
               filter(timepoint != "0",
                      host_strain == "C57BL/6J",
                      batch == "8"),
             by = join_by("probe_id", "batch")) %>% 
  mutate(log2fc = value_raw - day0_value_raw) %>% 
  distinct() 

#Check duplicates
mouse_exprs_log2fc_sample %>% 
  filter(subject_id == "Mouse_C57BL/6J_Animal1_Batch8",
         probe_id == "1415670_at")

```

```{r}
########### Filter and annotate probes -----
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- mouse_exprs$probe_id %>% unique()

# listAttributes(ensembl_mart)
#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("affy_mouse430_2",
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "affy_mouse430_2", #Probes
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Get lookup table from FIT
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = mouse_ortholog)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter probes with highest median expression
mouse_log2summary = mouse_exprs %>% #20,845 probes
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = affy_mouse430_2), 
            by = "probe") %>%  #24.009 rows
  #Filter ensembl id
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  
  #Filter entrez id
  group_by(entrezgene_id) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>%  #21.863 probes/entrez_ids
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(mouse_entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
  
  #Filter hgnc symbol
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, by = c("mouse_entrez", "mgi_symbol")) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1)  %>% #14.396
  ungroup()

#Filter out genes with multiple mgi_symbols
hgnc_symbol_dupes = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  #filter ensembl id with multiple mgi_symbols
  get_dupes(hgnc_symbol)

mouse_log2summary = mouse_log2summary %>% 
  select(probe, hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% c(hgnc_symbol_dupes$hgnc_symbol %>% unique())) 

#Modify expression matrix

#Filtered probes
mouse_log2_filtered_probes = mouse_exprs %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(probe = probe_id) %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_log2summary, by = "probe") %>%   #214,396
  select(human_symbol = hgnc_symbol,
         probe,
         c(mouse_metadata %>% 
             pull(geo_sample)))
#Check
mouse_log2_filtered_probes %>% dim()
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol = mouse_log2_filtered_probes 
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% get_dupes(human_symbol)

#Save
mouse_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")))

#Pivot to long and wide format, and annotate
mouse_log2_samples_log2fc_long = mouse_log2_filtered_probes %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(human_symbol, probe),
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_metadata,
             by = "geo_sample")


mouse_log2_samples_log2fc_wide = mouse_log2_samples_log2fc_long %>% 
  select(human_symbol, probe, subject_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "subject_id",
              values_from = "log2fc") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, timepoint %>% as.numeric()))

```

## Demographics

```{r}
#Import datasets
exprs_data = read_rds(file = here("tables", "influenza_GSE124689_exprs_not_normalized.rds"))
metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_metadata_clean.rds"))
log2_data = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_annotations_not_normalized_log2.rds"))
metadata_filtered = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_samples_pbmc.rds"))

#Bind mouse metadata to human data
human_mouse_metadata = metadata_filtered %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad") %>% 
  select(sample_id = geo_sample, 
         participant_id = subject_id, 
         vaccine = treatment,
         sex,
         strain,
         sample_type = tissue,
         timepoint,
         condition) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         type = "Inactivated",
         adjuvant = "MF59",
         age = 7, #6–8 weeks
         timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.numeric(.) / 24,
         timepoint = if_else(timepoint < 1 & timepoint != 0,
                             as.character(round(timepoint, 1)),
                             as.character(as.integer(round(timepoint, 0)))),
         race = strain, 
         array = "Agilent-028005 SurePrint G3 Mouse GE 8x60K Microarray") %>% 
  
  #Bind human data
  bind_rows(metadata %>% 
               select(sample_id,
                      participant_id,
                      condition, timepoint,
                      sex, age, race, vaccine, 
                      sample_type, array, 
                      type, adjuvant) %>% 
              mutate(organism = "Human",
                     vaccine = "Fluad",
                     timepoint = as.character(timepoint)))

human_mouse_metadata

human_mouse_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "framework_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))
```

# 2. Differential gene expression

## Pre-processing

### Calculate Log2FC manually

```{r}
#Import table
human_mouse_example_raw = readRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn.rds")) %>% 
  filter(measure %in% c("value_raw"))

# Calculate Log2-Fold Change ------
human_mouse_example_raw_log2fc <- human_mouse_example_raw %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("0", "1", "3", "7")) %>%
  select(participant_id, symbol, timepoint, value, measure, organism) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, symbol, measure) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")
```

```{r}
#Create Expression Set
```

## Modelling

### Mixed models

#### VariancePartition

```{r}
library("variancePartition")
#Design matrix
formula_dream <- ~ (1|timepoint) + (1 | participant_id)

#Fit
varPart <- fitExtractVarPartModel(mouse_fluad_matrix, formula_dream, mouse_fluad_metadata)

# sort variables by median fraction of variance explained
vp <- sortCols(varPart)

# Figure 1a
# Bar plot of variance fractions for the first 10 genes
plotPercentBars(vp[1:10, ])

# violin plot of contribution of each variable to total variance
plotVarPart(vp)


# get gene with the highest variation across Tissues
i <- which.max(varPart$timepoint)
# create data.frame with expression of gene i and timepoint type for each sample
GE <- data.frame(Expression = mouse_fluad_matrix[i, ], 
                 Timepoint = mouse_fluad_metadata$timepoint)

# Figure 2a
# plot expression stratified by Tissue
plotStratify(Expression ~ Timepoint, GE, 
             main = rownames(mouse_fluad_matrix)[i])
```

#### Limma

Paired samples design

```{r}
#Create model matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
                       eset_mouse) 
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples)
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse$participant_id)
corfit$consensus

#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse, design, 
             block = eset_mouse$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus) 

#Contrasts
#Get conditions
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFluad_4_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_8_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_24_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_48_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_72_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_168_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)

# eBayes
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs and clean dataset
all_degs_mouse = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionFluad_4_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_4_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_8_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_8_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_24_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_48_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_48_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_72_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_168_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA)) %>% 
  select(condition, everything())
	
# #Save
all_degs_mouse %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "Example_GSE120661_degs_mouse.rds"))
```

### T test

```{r}
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_fluad_mouse_exprs_clean_long.rds"))
#Import
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds")) %>% 
  distinct()
```

```{r}
#Compute summary statistics
fluad_log2fc_summary = mouse_fluad_log2fc_filtered_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = TRUE),  # mean log2 fold change
    n_subjects = n(),                         # number of samples
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),             # standard deviation
    se = sd / sqrt(n_subjects),               # standard error
    effect_size = avg_log2fc / sd)            # Cohen’s d-like effect size

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide = mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>%
  # rownames_to_column("human_symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -human_symbol,
               names_to = "geo_sample",
               values_to = "log2") %>% 
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
               select(geo_sample, participant_id, timepoint),
             by = "geo_sample") %>% 
  select(human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, value = log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") 

# Paired t-test
mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = TRUE, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Paired")

#Unpaired
mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest <- mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol_wide %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  
  summarise(
    pval_day1 = tryCatch(t.test(day_1, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day3 = tryCatch(t.test(day_3, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    pval_day7 = tryCatch(t.test(day_7, day_0, paired = F, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    padj_day1 = p.adjust(pval_day1, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day3 = p.adjust(pval_day3, method = "fdr"),
    padj_day7 = p.adjust(pval_day7, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("pval_", "padj_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "(pval|padj)_(day\\d+)"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(timepoint == "day1"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day3"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               timepoint == "day7"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~timepoint),
         timepoint = str_remove(timepoint, "day"),
         test = "t-Test",
         paired = "Unpaired")

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest = mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_ttest %>% 
  bind_rows(mouse_fluad_log2fc_unpaired_ttest) 

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds"))

```

## Get overlap

Input

```{r}
# Import datasets
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file = here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds"))
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# DEGs table
degs_all_updown = dge_long_genes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process = condition, genes = symbol)

# Metadata
annotation_metadata = dge_long_genes %>% 
  #Arrange columns in the desired order to be displayed on the heatmap
  dplyr::select(condition, 
                organism, 
                # type, 
                # vaccine, 
                timepoint)


#Inputs
filename = "Framework_Example"
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(stats::fisher.test)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))

```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human no mesmo timepoint ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Get combinations
timepoint_combinations <- expand.grid(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_genes <- intersect(human_df$human_symbol, mouse_df$human_symbol)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "human_symbol")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "human_symbol")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse)
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Human vs Human (entre timepoints) ---
cor_human_human <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, log2fc) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = participant_id,
    values_from = log2fc
  ) %>%
  select(-human_symbol, -timepoint) %>%   # só colunas de participantes
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
  melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>% 
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%   # tira a diagonal (=1)
  # garantir combinações únicas
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  #Summarize
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) 
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

#### 5 to 5 bootstrap

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# This script performs cross-species correlation (Human vs. Mouse)
# using the bootstrap method (1000 iterations), sampling 5 participants
# from each organism in each iteration.

# --- 1. BOOTSTRAP CONFIGURATION ---
timepoints_mouse = unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Mouse")  %>% pull(timepoint)) %>% as.numeric()
timepoints_human = unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human")  %>% pull(timepoint)) %>% as.numeric()

# --- 2. DATA PREPARATION AND FILTERING ---
# Filters raw log2fc data only for the relevant timepoints
data_filtered <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(timepoints_mouse, timepoints_human)) 

mouse_data <- data_filtered %>% filter(organism == "Mouse")
human_data <- data_filtered %>% filter(organism == "Human")

# --- 3. FUNCTION FOR A SINGLE BOOTSTRAP ITERATION ---

# This function performs a single bootstrap iteration for a timepoint.
# 1. Samples 5 Human and 5 Mouse IDs (with replacement).
# 2. Filters data for sampled IDs and common symbols (genes).
# 3. Calculates the cross-correlation matrix (5x5)

get_bootstrap_cors <- function(timepoint_mouse, timepoint_human, all_human_data, all_mouse_data, n_sample) {

  h_tp_data <- all_human_data %>% filter(timepoint == timepoint_human)
  m_tp_data <- all_mouse_data %>% filter(timepoint == timepoint_mouse)

  common_symbols <- intersect(h_tp_data$human_symbol, m_tp_data$human_symbol)

  if (length(unique(h_tp_data$participant_id)) < n_sample ||
      length(unique(m_tp_data$participant_id)) < n_sample ||
      length(common_symbols) == 0) {

    message(paste("No sufficient data for mouse timepoint:", timepoint_mouse))

    return(tibble(
      timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
      timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse,
      correlation = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  sampled_human <- sample(unique(h_tp_data$participant_id), n_sample, replace = TRUE)
  sampled_mouse <- sample(unique(m_tp_data$participant_id), n_sample, replace = TRUE)

  h_matrix <- h_tp_data %>%
    filter(participant_id %in% sampled_human, human_symbol %in% common_symbols) %>%
    distinct(human_symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  m_matrix <- m_tp_data %>%
    filter(participant_id %in% sampled_mouse, human_symbol %in% common_symbols) %>%
    distinct(human_symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  colnames(h_matrix) <- paste0("Human_", 1:ncol(h_matrix))
  colnames(m_matrix) <- paste0("Mouse_", 1:ncol(m_matrix))

  cross_cors <- cor(h_matrix, m_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

  tibble(
    timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
    timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse,
    correlation = as.vector(cross_cors)
  )
}


# --- 4. BOOTSTRAP EXECUTION ---
N_BOOTSTRAPS = 10    # Number of bootstrap iterations
SAMPLE_SIZE = 5       # 5 humans vs 5 mice in each iteration

# Creates a dataframe of bootstrap IDs and applies the function for all timepoints
bootstrapped_human_mouse_cors <- expand_grid(
  bootstrap_id = 1:N_BOOTSTRAPS,
  human_tp = timepoints_human,
  mouse_tp = timepoints_mouse
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    cors = list(
      get_bootstrap_cors(mouse_tp, 24, human_data, mouse_data, SAMPLE_SIZE)
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(cors)

# --- 5. BOOTSTRAP RESULTS SUMMARIZATION ---

# Calculates descriptive statistics on the distribution of correlations
# obtained by the 1000 bootstrap iterations (N_total = 1000 * 25 = 25000 observations)
correlation_bootstrap_summary <- bootstrapped_human_mouse_cors %>%
 group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Bootstrap Mouse vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    sd = sd(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    se = sd,
    ci_low = quantile(correlation, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(4),
    ci_high = quantile(correlation, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(4),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_human = as.character(timepoint_human),
         timepoint_mouse = as.character(timepoint_mouse),
         time_unit = "h")

correlation_bootstrap_summary
```

## Zscores - Mouse vs Human

Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile -----
#By zscores ------
#Mouse
zscore_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_mouse, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2m) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2m, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs Mouse") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2m,
         mean_model = mean_mouse,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_mouse) %>% 
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(
    quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Pivot and sum only DEGs
zscore_genes_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, model, deg) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
degs_pos_neg_summary_quantiles_best_worst_data <- zscore_genes_mouse %>%
  filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
         pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  mutate(
    quartiles_grouped = case_when(
      quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
      quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  drop_na(quartiles_grouped) %>% 
  group_by(comparison, timepoint, quartiles_grouped) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>%
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
  facet_wrap(~paste("Day", timepoint) ~comparison) +
  #All points, colored by differences
  geom_point(
             aes(color = quartile_label,
                 fill = quartile_label),
             pch = 21) +

  # #Same DEGs (WORST)
  geom_point(color = "#4DBBD5FF",
             fill = "#4DBBD5FF",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 1,
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes_mouse %>%
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c("Q50", "Q75", "Q100"))) +
  
  #Same DEGs (Worst, Immune)
  geom_point(color = "#4361ee",
             fill = "#4361ee",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 1, 
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes_mouse %>%
               filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>% 
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c("Q50", "Q75", "Q100"))) +
  #Same DEGs (BEST)
  geom_point(color = "black",
             fill = "#4DBBD5FF",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 2,
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes_mouse %>%
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c(
                 "Q10",
                 "Q25"
                 ))) +
  
  #Same DEGs (Best, Immune)
  geom_point(color = "black",
             fill = "#4361ee",
             alpha = 1,
             size = 2,
             pch = 21,
             data = zscore_genes_mouse %>%
               filter(human_symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes)) %>% 
               filter(comparison == "Human vs Mouse") %>%
               filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
                      pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>%
               filter(quartile_label %in% c(
                 "Q10",
                 "Q25"
                 ))) +
   #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Q10" = "black",
                               "Q25" = "gray25",
                               "Q50" = "gray50",
                               "Q75" = "gray75",
                               "Q100" = "gray90")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Q10" = "black",
                               "Q25" = "gray25",
                               "Q50" = "gray50",
                               "Q75" = "gray75",
                               "Q100" = "gray90")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4, 4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 4)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.key.width = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, vjust = 0.9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Mouse L2FC",
       y = "Human L2FC",
       alpha = "Quantiles",
       fill = "Quantiles",
       color = "|Z|")
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
# Enrichment analysis -------
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"
#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

#Discretize by quartile
df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse = zscore_genes_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<Q25",
    quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">Q75",
    TRUE ~ quartile_label)) %>% 
    mutate(condition = paste0(comparison, "", quartiles_grouped, " (", timepoint_day,")")) %>% 
  filter(quartiles_grouped != "Q50") %>% 
  select(genes = human_symbol,
         condition)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "(?<=\\(Day )\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = case_when(str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))

#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "Framework_Example_ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))
```

```{r}
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "Fluad_GSE120661_degs_mouse.rds"))
mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
```

```{r}
### Loop for every time point -----
all_degs_fit2 = all_degs_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, EffectSize = logFC, condition) %>%
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
               select(symbol = human_symbol, MM.Entrez = mouse_entrez),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(row = MM.Entrez)

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row") %>% 
    select(MM.Entrez, EffectSize)
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")

  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})
beep()
#Print
fit_results_combined

#Save
fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "FIT_FLUAD_alltimes.rds"))

fit_results_combined %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = log2fc,
      fill = condition,
      color = condition) +
  geom_histogram()
```

### Mean Log2FC and GSEA

Compare means and NES Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Ecoli")
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(immune_set == "BTM by Modules") %>%
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarize(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
```

```{r}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, log2fold_change)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "ImmuneGO_Human")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process, by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
  bind_rows(duplicated_human_data)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, group, Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        use = "pairwise.complete.obs", 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
   # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=9}
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse)

#Plot correlation plot (means)
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot =  dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
      y = mean_log2fc_Human,
      labels = process) +
    #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~timepoint, nrow = 1) +
  #Plot all points
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 color = group),
             size = 2,
             alpha = 0.2,
             pch = 21) +
  #Plot only significant in both
  geom_point(aes(fill = group),
             data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Human <= 0.25 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25), 
             color = "black",
             size = 2,
             alpha = 1,
             pch = 21) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  guides(color = F) +
  labs(fill = "Immune group",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)") +
  ylim(-2, 2) +
  xlim(-2, 2) +
  
  #Add correlation metrics
  geom_label(data = cor_labels,
            aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),
            fill= "white",
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  #Label only the top 10 processes with least difference in log2fc
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = process),
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  data = . %>% filter(p_adjust_Human <= 0.25 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25) %>%
                    mutate(diff = mean_log2fc_Human - mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>%
                    group_by(timepoint) %>% 
                    slice_min(n = 20, abs(diff)),
                  size = 1.5,
                  segment.size = 0.2,
                  lineheight = 0.8,
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.direction = "vertical",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0)
          )

#Print
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot

#Save results
dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_plot.png")),
         width = 9,
         height = 3)
```

### Sample-wise analysis

Annotate genes log2fc table with BTMs

```{r}
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

#Example input
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))

#Annotate genes by BTM 
results_genes_btm_df = samples_log2fc %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(symbol = human_symbol, participant_id = subject_id, geo_sample, timepoint, log2fc, organism) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol")

#Save
results_genes_btm_df %>% saveRDS(file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_log2fc_long.rds")))


#Pivot wider
dge_btm_mean_process = results_genes_btm_df %>%
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarize(mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% 
               select(process, group, subgroup) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process

#Save
dge_btm_mean_process %>% saveRDS(file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_log2fc.rds")))

```

Import data from different organisms

```{r}
#Genes L2FC table annotated with BTMs
dge_btm_mean_process_samples = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_btm_samples_log2fc_long.rds")) 

#Import metadata
mouse_human_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Calculate the mean log2fc by module
dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long = results_genes_btm_df %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(organism == "Human", "24", timepoint)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, participant_id, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarize(group,
            subgroup, 
            mean_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup()

#Pivot wider
dge_btm_mean_process_sample_wide = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "participant_id", 
              values_from = "mean_log2fc")
```

##### Means

###### Sample mice and humans, plot a scatterplot

Scatterplot

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# Annotate genes by BTM and reshape to wide (participants as columns)
dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  mutate(
    # participant_id = str_remove(participant_id, "PAXGENEENR.CEL") %>% str_remove("rep"),
    participant_id = paste0(organism, "_", participant_id)
  ) 

# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants,
         timepoint == 24) %>%
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_value = cor(mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2))
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

cor_labels

# ---- Plot ----
timepoint_selected = 2
samples_btm_scatterplot = plot_data %>%
  filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_log2fc_mouse, y = mean_log2fc_human)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group), alpha = 0.2, size = 2, color = "black", pch = 21) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 1, se = F, size = 1) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_label(
    data = cor_labels %>% 
      filter(timepoint_mouse == timepoint_selected),
    aes(x = 0, y = Inf, label = cor_label),
    hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(~participant_id_human~participant_id_mouse, scales = "free") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  xlim(-3, 3) +
  ylim(-3, 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = immune_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Mouse Log2FC",
    y = "Human Log2FC",
    title = paste0(filename, ", Mouse vs. Human, samples")
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

samples_btm_scatterplot

samples_btm_scatterplot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_samples_group_scatterplot.png")),
```

```{r}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human no mesmo timepoint ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Get combinations
timepoint_combinations <- expand.grid(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_process <- intersect(human_df$process, mouse_df$process)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "process")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "process")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human %>% as.numeric(),
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse %>% as.numeric())
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_human_mouse_timepoint

# --- 2) Human vs Human (entre timepoints) ---
cor_human_human <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  select(participant_id, process, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = participant_id,
    values_from = mean_log2fc
  ) %>%
  select(-process, -timepoint) %>%   # só colunas de participantes
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
  melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>% 
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%   # tira a diagonal (=1)
  # garantir combinações únicas
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  #Summarize
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = 24,
         timepoint_human = timepoint)
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc) %>%
      select(-process)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), 
         timepoint_mouse = timepoint)


#Unite
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    cor_human_human,
    cor_mouse_mouse)

#Print
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

#### ssGSEA

Import data

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  rename(participant_id = subject_id) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)

#ssGSEA-----
#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol) %>% 
  group_by(process) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(genes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

ssgsea_log2fc_matrix = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "log2fold_change") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genes") %>% 
  as.matrix()


# Run ssGSEA
df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice = ssgsea(ssgsea_log2fc_matrix, term2gene, scale = F, minsize = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  setNames(ssgsea_metadata$condition) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("process") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -process,
               names_to = "condition",
               values_to = "nes") %>% 
  mutate(pvalue = z2p(nes), #Convert NES into pvalue
         p_adjust = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
         geneset_name = "BTMs") %>%
  inner_join(ssgsea_metadata, by= "condition") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes %>% select(process, group) %>% distinct(),
             by = "process")
  

df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_ssGSEA_btms_results.rds")))

beep()
```

###### Sample mice and humans, plot a scatterplot

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# ---- Sampling 5 Human + 5 Mouse ----
set.seed(31415)

sample_participants = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  select(organism, participant_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pull(participant_id)
  

# ---- Build pairwise dataset ----
plot_data = df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  filter(organism == "Human", 
         participant_id %in% sample_participants,
         timepoint == "24") %>%
  inner_join(df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
              filter(organism == "Mouse", 
                     participant_id %in% sample_participants),
             by = join_by("process", "group"), suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")) %>% 
  select(process, group, participant_id_human, participant_id_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse,  nes_human, nes_mouse) 

# ---- Compute correlations per participant pair ----
cor_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id_mouse, participant_id_human, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(
      x = nes_human,
      y = nes_mouse,
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "estimate"),
    p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, "p.value"),
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-test)
cor_labels

# ---- Plot ----

  labs(
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Ecoli")

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Import Hallmarks -------
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"
#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, symbol = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_")) %>% 
  distinct()

#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_hallmarks_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_df, by = "symbol")

dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))

dge_hallmarks_mean_process = dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarize(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

#Print
dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
```

```{r}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = msigdbr_df %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, log2fold_change)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_hallmarks_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "MSigDB Hallmarks")


gsea_hallmarks_results = gsea_hallmarks_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  inner_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process, by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_hallmarks_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
  pull(process) %>%

                         "#4DBBD5FF", "gray50"))  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct() %>%
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Mouse vs Human

dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_results_matched %>%

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(mean_l2fc_Human)



#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        use = "pairwise.complete.obs", 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "all",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>%  
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

cor_labels_sig <- dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
    inner_join(dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>% select(process, timepoint, p_adjust_Mouse, p_adjust_Human) %>% 
               filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_Human <= 0.25),
             by = join_by("process", "timepoint")) %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        use = "pairwise.complete.obs", 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(filter = "filtered",
         r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
    p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
    p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
    p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "ns"
  ),
    
    cor_label = paste0("r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

##### Summarize inter-individual correlation

##### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human no mesmo timepoint ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Get combinations
timepoint_combinations <- expand.grid(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_process <- intersect(human_df$process, mouse_df$process)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "process")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "process")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human %>% as.numeric(),
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse %>% as.numeric())
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_human_mouse_timepoint

# --- 2) Human vs Human (entre timepoints) ---
cor_human_human <- dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  select(participant_id, process, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = participant_id,
    values_from = mean_log2fc
  ) %>%
  select(-process, -timepoint) %>%   # só colunas de participantes
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
  melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>% 
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%   # tira a diagonal (=1)
  # garantir combinações únicas
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  #Summarize
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = 24,
         timepoint_human = timepoint)
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- dge_hallmarks_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc) %>%
      select(-process)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), 
         timepoint_mouse = timepoint)


#Unite
correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    cor_human_human,
    cor_mouse_mouse)

#Print
correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_hallmarks_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_hallmarks_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

#### ssGSEA

Import data

```{r}
#Import data ---------
samples_log2fc = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

filename = "ecoli_infection_human_mouse"

#Raw data
ssgsea_pre_data = samples_log2fc %>% 
  rename(participant_id = subject_id) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(participant_id, "_Day", timepoint)) 

#Get metadata
ssgsea_metadata = ssgsea_pre_data %>% 
  select(condition, participant_id, organism, timepoint) %>% distinct()

library(corto)
```

##### Summarize inter-individual correlation

##### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human no mesmo timepoint ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Get combinations
timepoint_combinations <- expand.grid(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, nes)
    
    mouse_df <- df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, nes)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_process <- intersect(human_df$process, mouse_df$process)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = nes)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = nes)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "process")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "process")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human %>% as.numeric(),
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse %>% as.numeric())
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_human_mouse_timepoint

# --- 2) Human vs Human (entre timepoints) ---
cor_human_human <- df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  select(participant_id, process, timepoint, nes) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = participant_id,
    values_from = nes
  ) %>%
  select(-process, -timepoint) %>%   # só colunas de participantes
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
  melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>% 
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%   # tira a diagonal (=1)
  # garantir combinações únicas
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  #Summarize
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = 24,
         timepoint_human = timepoint)
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- df_genes2ssGSEA_human_mice %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, process, nes) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = nes) %>%
      select(-process)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), 
         timepoint_mouse = timepoint)
```

# 6. Performance tests

## ROC Curve: Genes

Do for one direction (up and then down) Do one sided t test for mouse,
fit, and human Positive control: Human Neg control: Random permutation

Import data

```{r}
#Import DEGs table
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file= here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds"))
```

Inputs

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
set.seed(123)
######### Input -----
filename = "Frameworks"
gene_set_filename = "All_OnlyImmune"
genes_df_input = bind_rows(
  genes_roc_allgenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
  genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
)

# filename = "Frameworks"
```
